bodyHtml:
HP-130 Hydronic Expansion Tank

130-Liter (34 Gallon) Extra-High Capacity Tank for Hydronic Heating & Cooling Systems | Aquasky HYDRO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

HP-130 is a 130-liter (34-gallon) expansion tank engineered for closed-loop hydronic systems. It reliably absorbs thermal expansion to regulate pressure buildup, ensuring the safety of large-scale residential and commercial heating and cooling setups.

Designed for high-performance, it supports pressures up to 10 bar (150 psi) and temperatures up to 130°C (266°F). The tank is factory pre-charged to 1 bar (15 psi) and is fully compatible with propylene glycol mixtures of up to 50%.

With a diameter of 55.0 cm and a height of 79.2 cm, this floor-standing model features a heavy-duty base for maximum stability. It offers massive expansion capacity in a robust, professional-grade design for systems with high fluid volumes.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The HP-130 is a 130-liter (34 gallon) hydronic expansion tank engineered specifically for closed-loop hydronic heating and cooling systems. As the fluid in your climate-control system changes temperature, it expands and contracts; the HP-130 safely absorbs this expanded fluid volume, effectively controlling the excessive pressure generated inside the system and preventing potential hazards.

Constructed from robust sheet steel tanks compliant with IAPMO and EN standards, the HP-130 is welded according to strict ASME & EN procedures by certified welders, ensuring long-lasting durability and safety. Utilizing a specialized, high-temperature-resistant EPDM rubber diaphragm, it ensures exceptionally reliable operation. To guarantee supreme robustness, every single Hydro-Plus model undergoes rigorous hydraulic testing at a pressure 1.5 times higher than the design pressure.

Manufactured with premium materials, Aquasky HYDRO-PLUS tanks are the ultimate safety choice for your hydronic heating system, delivering dependable performance and peace of mind.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • High-temperature resistant EPDM diaphragm for frequent heating/cooling cycles.
  • Durable cold-rolled carbon steel shell, welded to ASME & EN standards by certified welders.
  • 1.5x hydraulic pressure tested for safety and leak prevention.
  • Brass cap with internal O-ring ensures zero air loss from the air-vent.
  • Compatible with up to 50% propylene glycol, versatile for anti-freeze and commercial chillers.
  • Protective gray paint for professional appearance and environmental resistance.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the HYDRO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

In closed hydronic heating and cooling systems, fluid volume changes drastically as the temperature rises and falls. The HP-130 safely absorbs this expanded fluid using a sealed, compressible air cushion space. It stores the fluid securely against the high-temperature EPDM rubber diaphragm, while the air chamber compresses to accommodate the volume change. This mechanism seamlessly controls excessive pressure, protects valves and piping, and maintains safe system parameters without venting fluid.

Key benefits

  • Absorbs excess fluid volume during thermal cycles.
  • Protects system components (boilers, piping, valves) from damaging high pressure. 
  • Delivers a safe and stable system for residential and commercial hydronic applications. 
  • Guarantees peace of mind through strict manufacturing standards and a 1.5x design pressure hydraulic test.

Typical Applications 

  • Large-scale closed-loop residential and commercial hydronic heating systems
  • High-capacity hydronic cooling installations
  • Non-potable water applications (compatible with up to 50% propylene glycol mixtures)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Can this tank handle sudden pressure surges in a commercial heating system?

A: Absolutely. To provide maximum safety and peace of mind, every Hydro-Plus model undergoes rigorous factory hydraulic testing at 1.5 times its standard design pressure. This ensures the tank remains structurally sound and leak-proof even if the system experiences an unexpected pressure spike.

Q2 : Does the HP-130 feature larger plumbing connections for high-flow systems?

A: Yes, the HP-130 is upgraded with a massive 1-1/4 inch connection specifically designed to meet the high-flow requirements of commercial applications. This larger port ensures lower resistance and more efficient expansion absorption, allowing the tank to integrate seamlessly into heavy-duty hydronic networks.

Q3 : Is the HP-130 safe to use with antifreeze mixtures?

A: Yes. The HP-130 is fully compatible with propylene glycol mixtures in concentrations of up to 50%, making it ideal for systems exposed to freezing temperatures or specialized cooling loops.
